closed_baseline_decisions.HD-03: T_required is independent operational survival window

closed_baseline_decisions.E3_policy: In emergency mode, dynamically preserve resource with larger survivability margin

policy_options.name: Zero-Renewable Emergency Survivability Baseline
policy_options.proposed_wording: The Emergency Mode Detector shall evaluate station fuel and battery survivability through T_required assuming zero future renewable generation (P_solar = 0, P_wind = 0) as a detector-local stress scenario. Normal MPC optimization shall continue using standard causal forecasts without modification.
